title: 第25章 人前显圣第26章 个方算计许家危机
content_zh:
皇帝眼角抽了抽。
他属实没想到，这二人竟会落败！
剑修当真恐怖如斯！
虽然震惊，可他手上却不含糊，双手齐出，挡住两柄剑！
“好手段！”
下一刻，许渊出现在皇帝身前不远处。
而青玄与血杀两柄剑，则护卫在了许小凡的身边。
许渊皱眉看着皇帝，依旧看不破对方的实力。
于是也就放弃了。
不过他有种预感，对方超乎想象的强！
这时皇帝道：
“刚刚朕的旨意，听见了吗？”
许渊点了点头，道：
“多谢。”
皇帝笑着道：
“不用谢，你又立功了。”
群臣：“...”
许渊眼睛眯了眯，不知道这皇帝究竟什么意思。
他父子二人今日大闹寿宴。
儿子杀了太子，父亲当着皇帝的面，杀了户部尚书。

按理说，他们父子二人必然遭到全力追杀。
但这皇帝的态度，很不对劲！
事出反常必有妖！
许渊隐约间，嗅到了一丝阴谋的味道。
不过具体皇帝想干什么，他现在还看不穿。
但他却也并不太担心。
兵来将挡，水来土掩即可！
“小许贼，你杀我儿，今日便给他陪葬吧！”
这时，一道怒吼传来！
许小凡二话不说，迅速退至许渊身后！
众人循声望去，开口的却是一脸狼狈，目眦欲裂的杨无敌。
接着，众人又看着许小凡。
一脸不可思议！
杀一个太子已经是大逆不道，这货居然还敢杀杨家少主？
这小许贼，是疯了吧！
而杨无敌，不管不顾直接杀向许小凡！
与此同时，许渊嘴角勾勒出了一抹笑容。
因为他面前，浮现出了一行文字。
【叮，检测到您儿子得罪了紫府境初期强者，宿主修为自动提升至紫府境初期，且同境无敌！
许渊看着拼命燃烧紫府，朝自己杀来的杨无敌，不屑一笑。

一个巴掌，同时落在杨无敌脸上！
content_en:
The emperor's eyes twitched.
He really didn't expect that these two people would lose!
Sword cultivators are so terrifying!
Although he was shocked, he was unambiguous and used both hands to block the two swords!
"What a trick!"
The next moment, Xu Yuan appeared not far in front of the emperor.
The two swords Qingxuan and Xuesha were guarding Xu Xiaofan.
Xu Yuan frowned and looked at the emperor, still unable to discern the opponent's strength.
So I gave up.
But he had a hunch that the other party was stronger than he imagined!
At this time the emperor said:
"Did you hear my decree just now?"
Xu Yuan nodded and said:
"Thank you."
The emperor smiled and said:
"You're welcome, you've done something good again."
Ministers: "..."
Xu Yuan narrowed his eyes, wondering what the emperor meant.
His father and son were having a birthday party today.
The son killed the prince, and the father killed the minister of household affairs in front of the emperor.
It stands to reason that the father and son must be hunted down with all their might.
But there is something very wrong with the emperor's attitude!
When something goes wrong, there must be a monster!
Xu Yuan vaguely smelled a hint of conspiracy.
But he still can't see clearly what the emperor wants to do.
But he wasn't too worried.
The soldiers will block it, and the water will cover it with soil!
"Little thief Xu, if you kill my son, you can bury him with him today!"
At this time, a roar came!
Xu Xiaofan quickly retreated behind Xu Yuan without saying a word!
Everyone looked around, but the one who spoke was Yang Wudi, who looked embarrassed and his eyes were about to burst.
Then, everyone looked at Xu Xiaofan again.
Looks incredible!
Killing a prince is already treason, but this guy actually dares to kill the young master of the Yang family?
This little thief is crazy!
And Yang Wudi didn't care and went straight to kill Xu Xiaofan!
At the same time, a smile appeared on Xu Yuan's lips.
Because a line of text appeared in front of him.
[Ding, it’s been detected that your son has offended a strong person in the early stage of Zifu Realm. The host’s cultivation will be automatically upgraded to the early stage of Zifu Realm, and he will be invincible in the same realm!
Xu Yuan looked at Yang Wudi who was trying his best to burn Zi Mansion and kill him, and smiled disdainfully.
A slap fell on Yang Wudi's face at the same time!
